input.comment: [Playbook] We added an Array indemnity for Third Party claims that the licensed Products infringe Third Party intellectual property rights, with the usual modification and combination carve-outs, because our playbook requires the licensor to stand behind IP infringement claims arising from the rights it licenses to us. As drafted, Section 16.2 covers only Array's own activities and Article 15 breaches, while Section 11.4 leaves us bearing our own defence costs for infringement claims on Array's technology.
input.summary: Add third-party IP infringement indemnity from Array to Ono in Section 16.2 with standard modification/combination exclusions.
